tools.name: project_open
tools.title: Open project or model file
tools.description: Open a .3mf, .stl, .step, or .obj file as the session project. Replaces any previously opened project. Returns a summary: plate count, object names, and the active printer/filament/process presets. For plain geometry files (.stl/.step/.obj) the current default presets are applied. Use project_inspect for more detail after opening.

path.description: Absolute path to the file to open.

tools.name: project_inspect
tools.title: Inspect current project
tools.description: Return the current project's structure at the requested detail level. 'summary' (default): plate count, object count, active preset names, modified-setting count, warnings. 'plates': per-plate object lists and per-plate setting overrides. 'objects': per-object geometry stats (size, triangle count), transforms, and per-object setting modifiers. Start with 'summary'; request deeper levels only when needed.

plate_id.description: Restrict 'plates' or 'objects' detail to one plate (1-based). Omit for all plates.
